observations: Printed wetU16.51mg/kg differs from prose16.52; no preferred corrected value.
All initial-culture ratios fail a direct identity with the corresponding content/water quotient. Water rounding can affect wet/dry calculations; no blanket correction selected.

Cross-column factors range from 4.873973381086195535162163930 to 4.908451739683782386405759374. Their similar scale does not establish an exact common constant, correction or hidden denominator; small printed values are sensitive to rounding.
SI contains published means/ratios and predicted genomic annotations, not underlying sample IDs, uncertainty sheets or compartment balances.
